```php
<?php

namespace App\Policies;

use App\Models\User;
use App\Models\Expense;
use Illuminate\Auth\CanSeeAs;
use Illuminate\Auth\CanViewAny;
use Illuminate\Auth\CanCreate;
use Illuminate\Auth\CanUpdate;
use Illuminate\Auth\CanDelete;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Auth\Authorizable;

class ExpensePolicy implements Authorizable
{
    use CanSeeAs, CanViewAny, CanCreate, CanUpdate, CanDelete;

    public function view(User $user, Expense $expense): bool
    {
        // Implement your logic here
        return $user->can('view', $expense);
    }

    public function create(User $user): bool
    {
        // Implement your logic here
        return $user->can('create', Expense::class);
    }

    public function update(User $user, Expense $expense): bool
    {
        // Implement your logic here
        return $user->can('update', $expense);
    }

    public function delete(User $user, Expense $expense): bool
    {
        // Implement your logic here
        return $user->can('delete', $expense);
    }
}
```
